attribution: Lee et al., RoboReward, arXiv:2601.00675v2, Appendix A.2.2. Definitions faithfully restated; no additional grading rules.
scope: Evaluate the state at the end of the episode. Disregard time limits.

grades.level_1: No Success: At termination, nothing has changed in a way relevant to the instructed goal.
grades.level_2: Minimal Progress: The outcome advances the goal slightly, but that advance is inadequate.
grades.level_3: Partial Completion: Substantial progress is present at termination, while at least two requirements remain unmet, or one unmet requirement is major.
grades.level_4: Near Completion: The outcome has the intended region and intent, with exactly one minor requirement unmet.
grades.level_5: Perfect Completion: Every requirement is met in the terminal state.
